convert_ccd_residue_to_one_letter: use letters_three_to_one to convert a CCD residue name like CYS to its single letter code C
lookup_standard_protein_types: reference PROTEIN_TYPES to get the tuple of 20 standard amino acid three-letter codes
map_one_letter_to_int: use PROTEIN_TYPES_ONE_LETTER_TO_INT to convert a single letter amino acid code to its integer index
convert_one_to_three_letter: use PROTEIN_COMMON_ONE_TO_THREE to map a single letter amino acid code to its three-letter CCD name
check_polymer_type_order: use POLYMER_TYPES_ORDER to get the integer index of any protein or nucleic acid residue type
